goals.title: Goals
goals.intro: Set your daily targets. Values marked Estimate come from general formulas using the details you enter here. They are not medical advice.
goals.detailsNote: Used only to calculate estimates on this screen. Your profile is not changed.
goals.adjustmentHint: Starts at 20% for fat loss and 10% for muscle gain. You can change it.
goals.fixFields: Fill in the marked fields to calculate an estimate.
goals.stale: Your details changed since this estimate was calculated. Recalculate to update it. If you save without recalculating, these values are saved as your own goals, not as an estimate.
goals.floorNote: The calorie target is set to your estimated basal metabolic rate (BMR) because the adjusted calories would have been lower than that.
goals.waterNote: The water estimate (35 ml per kg of body weight) is preliminary and is not medical advice.
goals.optionalNote: Leave calories or macros empty if you don't want a target for them.
goals.weeklyNote: Choose your own target, from 0 to 14 workouts a week.
goals.savedEstimate: Saved. Values still marked Estimate remain estimates.
goals.loadFailed: Your saved goals couldn't be read, so saving is turned off to avoid replacing them. Try reloading.
goals.calorieConflict: With these details your estimated calorie need is above the largest target this app can store (6000 kcal), so no estimate can be shown. Check your details or enter your goals yourself.
goals.savedStale: Saved as your own goals. They were not recalculated after your details changed.
